newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho says Bock to step down as chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho says Bock to step down as chief exec.

text.p: Lonrho Plc said on Tuesday that Dieter Bock is to step down as chief executive and become the group's deputy chairman.
In a statement, Lonrho said Bock will be replaced as chief executive by Lonrho deputy managing director Nicholas Morrell.
Bock also said the company expects to announce the "successful sale of Metropole and Princess Hotels shortly."

Bock said the acquisition by South Africa's Anglo American Corp of a further 18.3 percent of Lonrho from Bock's Laerstate BV, which was announced earlier on Tuesday, "will further strengthen our ability to develop our mining interests."

Bock has previously declared his ambition to become chief executive of the Lonrho trading business, which is to be spun off after Lonrho has sold its hotel interests. Bock said this aim "will be better pursued from a non-executive position."
Lonrho intends to focus purely on its mining interests.
